annotations.title: Which US ETFs hold a stock, and at what weight

description: For one stock, the covered US ETFs that hold it and the weight in each, heaviest first. Each holder carries its holdings date, its source (the issuer's daily file or an SEC filing), the stock's rank in the fund and the dollars held. Returns the largest holders and the total count, how many funds have it as their largest holding, and the funds with the most dollars in it. It also says whether the stock is in VOO, SPY, IVV, QQQ, VTI, SCHD and the largest sector funds. It adds the issuers holding the most, the cheapest exposure per $1,000, funds whose name only shares the company's, and one sentence to quote.

compact.description: true for the counts, rank_summary, name_collision and the sentence to quote, without top_by_value, membership, by_issuer and fee_per_1000 and without each fund's rank, positions and value: about half the length.

ticker.description: A stock ticker, for example NVDA. A line listed outside the US carries its market after a dot, for example 7203.JP (Toyota in Tokyo), SAN.FR (Sanofi in Paris) or 005930.KR (Samsung Electronics); an earlier key without the market, such as 7203, is read as the key it became. A key ending in .PFD is not a market: it is the issuer's preferred shares, a US line apart from the common stock (JPM.PFD, held by preferred stock funds).

top.description: How many funds to return, heaviest first.
